name: Shellac
aliases: E904, shellac, bleached shellac, goma laca, laca blanqueada
what_is: A purified and bleached lac resin secreted by the female insect Laccifer lacca.
why_botia: Glazing agent of direct insect origin — non-vegan and subject to religious dietary review.
can_1: Identify E904 or Shellac on ingredient lists.
can_2: Alert vegan, vegetarian, and Muslim consumers of its insect origin.
cannot_1: Determine whether the shellac used is wax-free or contains up to 5.5% wax.
cannot_2: Confirm if treated with unapproved bleaching agents during purification.
title: Shellac
description: A purified and bleached lac resin secreted by the female insect Laccifer lacca.
